rationale: A burst water supply line (the policyholder's own plumbing) caused flooding to the basement, resulting in damage to the home's structure and contents, which is clearly property damage to the policyholder's own dwelling.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement flooded due to a burst water supply line under the upstairs bathroom sink that ran for approximately two days while the policyholder was away. Damage includes buckled hardwood flooring, soaked drywall to approximately one foot height, and ruined storage boxes. This is a high-severity claim requiring on-site assessment given the structural damage and extent of water intrusion.

case_facts.description: Basement flooded with approximately 2 inches of water across entire basement
case_facts.property_damage: Hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked to approximately 1 foot height, stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: Burst water supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately 2 days

rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof shingles is direct property damage to the home structure.
claim_summary: Wind-driven storm damage on last weekend blew four shingles off the back porch overhang. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no interior water intrusion. Note: claim amount falls below the $2,500 deductible on this policy.

case_facts.damage_description: four shingles blown off, no water damage to interior
